function.name: opentype_get_table_ptr
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to a specific table within a TrueType Collection (TTC) or SFNT font, given the table tag. It also retrieves the size of the table.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the font data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the font data.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the TTC or SFNT structure.

parameters.name: table_tag
parameters.description: Tag of the table to retrieve.

parameters.name: table_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the pointer to the table.

parameters.name: table_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the size of the table.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the table was found and the pointers were set. Returns FALSE otherwise.

function.name: opentype_get_tt_os2_v1
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to the 'OS/2' table in a TrueType or OpenType font, and returns whether the operation was successful or not.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the font data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the font data.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the 'sfnt' structure that describes the font.

parameters.name: tt_os2_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that will be set to the location of the 'OS/2' table.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation was successful, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: opentype_get_tt_head
function.description: This function gets the TrueType font header from the OpenType font data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the OpenType font data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the OpenType font data.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the TTC_SFNT_V1 structure that contains information about the font.

parameters.name: tt_head
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a TT_HEAD structure that receives the TrueType font header.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully gets the TrueType font header, otherwise FALSE.

function.name: get_name_record_codepage
function.description: This function returns the codepage based on the platform and encoding provided. It uses switch cases to determine the appropriate codepage.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: This parameter represents the platform for which the codepage is needed.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: This parameter represents the encoding for which the codepage is needed.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the codepage corresponding to the provided platform and encoding.

function.name: get_name_record_langid
function.description: This function returns the language identifier (LANGID) for a given platform, encoding, and language. It handles different platforms and encodings, and provides warnings for invalid or unknown inputs.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform for which the LANGID is to be obtained

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: The encoding used on the platform

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language for which the LANGID is to be obtained

function.return_type: LANGID, which represents the language identifier for the given platform, encoding, and language

function.name: opentype_enum_font_names
function.description: This function enumerates the font names in the OpenType format. It handles different name formats and calls a callback function for each valid name record.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the header structure of the OpenType font.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform ID for which the font names are to be enumerated.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name ID for which the font names are to be enumerated.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback function that is called for each valid name record.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Pointer to user-defined data that is passed to the callback function.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the enumeration was successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: opentype_get_ttc_sfnt_v1
function.description: This function checks the validity of a font file, verifies its format, and retrieves specific font information.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the font data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the font data.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the font to be retrieved.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the number of fonts will be stored.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer where the retrieved font information will be stored.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: opentype_get_tt_name_v0
function.description: This function retrieves the pointer to the table of a TrueType font file.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be processed.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the data to be processed.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure representing the TrueType Collection (TTC) font file.

parameters.name: tt_name_v0
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the structure representing the name table of the TrueType font file.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: opentype_enum_family_names
function.description: This function enumerates font family names for different platforms and returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation was successful or not.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the header structure of the font.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback function to be invoked for each enumerated name.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Pointer to user-defined data.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the font family names were successfully enumerated for any platform, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: opentype_enum_style_names
function.description: This function enumerates the style names of a font from different platforms (Windows, Mac, Unicode). If it finds a style name, it returns TRUE, otherwise it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the header structure of the font

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback function to be invoked for each style name found

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Pointer to user-defined data to be passed to the callback function

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if a style name is found, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: opentype_enum_full_names
function.description: This function enumerates full names of the font for different platforms (Windows, Mac, Unicode). If it finds the full name for any platform, it returns TRUE, otherwise FALSE.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the header structure of the font

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback function to handle the enumerated names

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Pointer to user data that may be used in the callback function

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the full name of the font was found for any platform or not

function.name: opentype_get_properties
function.description: This function retrieves the properties of an OpenType font.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data of the OpenType font.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the data.

parameters.name: ttc_sfnt_v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the TTC_SFNT_V1 structure that contains information about the font.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD that receives the version of the font.

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Pointer to a FONTSIGNATURE structure that receives the font signature.

parameters.name: ntm_flags
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD that receives the flags that indicate the font's characteristics.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT that receives the font's weight.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the properties of the font, or FALSE otherwise.
